question: Where is the nearest restaurant you’d find going toward the Beverly Collective, Broomfield, CO starting at Action Behavior Centers - ABA therapy for Autism, Longmont, CO?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-105.123738 40.136268)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-105.134049 39.933726)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-105.123738 40.136268)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-105.123738 40.136268)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;
